resources.name: tablemaker-test
resources.description: piptm Plumber API test collection

resources.name: GET /health
resources.description: Confirms the API is up. Always run this first.

resources.name: GET /releases
resources.description: Lists all loaded releases and flags the current one.

resources.name: GET /surveys
resources.description: Full survey manifest. Grab pip_id values from here for /table and /lookup.

resources.name: POST /session/surveys - create session
resources.description: Creates a new session with pip_id values and returns session_id for recovery.

resources.name: GET /session/<id>/surveys - retrieve session
resources.description: Retrieves stored pip_id values by session_id. Run POST request first to set session_id env var.

resources.name: POST /session/surveys - missing pip_id (400)
resources.description: Expects 400. pip_id is required and cannot be empty.

resources.name: POST /session/surveys - invalid pip_id format (400)
resources.description: Expects 400. pip_id must match pattern CCC_YYYY_*.

resources.name: GET /session/<id>/surveys - unknown session (404)
resources.description: Expects 404. Nonexistent or expired session returns not found.

resources.name: POST /session/surveys - roundtrip test (5 surveys)
resources.description: Full workflow test: create session with 5 surveys, verify stored correctly.

resources.name: GET /table - basic (mean + gini)
resources.description: Basic table request with mean and gini measures

resources.name: POST /table - basic
resources.description: Same as GET but body-encoded. Useful for many pip_ids.

resources.name: GET /table - poverty status
resources.description: analysis_var=pov_status requires poverty_line

resources.name: GET /table - by gender
resources.description: Tests the 'by' disaggregation parameter

resources.name: GET /table - with filter_base
resources.description: Tests sample-base filtering. Adjust filter_base keys/values from /categories.

resources.name: GET /table - suppression disabled
resources.description: Omitting pop_share_threshold disables cell suppression

resources.name: ERR - pov_status missing poverty_line
resources.description: Expects 400. poverty_line is required when analysis_var=pov_status

resources.name: ERR - non-integer ppp
resources.description: Expects 400. ppp must be a positive whole number

resources.name: ERR - nonexistent pip_id
resources.description: Expects 400 with meaningful error, not 500

resources.name: GET /table - by pov_status
resources.description: Valid use of pov_status as disaggregation dimension with poverty_line.

resources.name: GET /table - binary analysis shares
resources.description: Shares path with binary analysis variable.

resources.name: GET /table - continuous analysis
resources.description: Summary stats path with continuous analysis variable.

resources.name: GET /table - multiple pip_id
resources.description: Vectorized pip_id query parameter (repeatable).

resources.name: GET /table - empty pop_share_threshold
resources.description: Explicit empty threshold should disable suppression.

resources.name: ERR - missing analysis_var
resources.description: Expects 400. analysis_var is required.

resources.name: ERR - missing pip_id
resources.description: Expects 400. pip_id is required.

resources.name: ERR - missing measures
resources.description: Expects 400. measures is required.

resources.name: ERR - unknown analysis_var
resources.description: Expects 400. analysis_var must be in allowlist.

resources.name: ERR - unknown measure
resources.description: Expects 400. Unknown measures are rejected.

resources.name: ERR - invalid by dimension
resources.description: Expects 400. Unknown by dimensions are rejected.

resources.name: ERR - by pov_status missing poverty_line
resources.description: Expects 400. poverty_line required when by includes pov_status.

resources.name: ERR - poverty_line non-numeric
resources.description: Expects 400. poverty_line must be numeric.

resources.name: ERR - poverty_line non-positive
resources.description: Expects 400. poverty_line must be > 0.

resources.name: ERR - invalid pip_id format
resources.description: Expects 400. pip_id must match canonical uppercase pattern.

resources.name: ERR - too many pip_id values
resources.description: Expects 400. More than 15 pip_id values are rejected.

resources.name: ERR - ppp zero
resources.description: Expects 400. ppp must be positive.

resources.name: ERR - ppp negative
resources.description: Expects 400. ppp must be positive.

resources.name: ERR - repeated ppp values
resources.description: Expects 400. ppp must be a scalar.

resources.name: ERR - pop_share_threshold non-numeric
resources.description: Expects 400. pop_share_threshold must be numeric in (0,1).

resources.name: ERR - pop_share_threshold out of range
resources.description: Expects 400. pop_share_threshold must be strictly between 0 and 1.

resources.name: ERR - malformed filter_base JSON
resources.description: Expects 422. filter_base JSON parsing fails in handler.

resources.name: ERR - table unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: POST /table - missing analysis_var
resources.description: Expects 400. analysis_var required in POST body.

resources.name: POST /table - malformed JSON
resources.description: Expects 400. Invalid JSON body should fail request parsing.

resources.name: ERR - /surveys unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: ERR - /surveys-ui unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: ERR - /countries unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: ERR - /regions unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: ERR - /statistics unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: ERR - /analysis-variables unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: ERR - /categories unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: ERR - /covariates unknown release
resources.description: Expects 422. resolve_release rejects unknown release.

resources.name: GET /table - single survey with gender+area
resources.description: Happy path: real production survey with common dimension breakdown. Validates response structure and data quality.

resources.name: GET /table - 5 surveys batch
resources.description: Medium batch: 5 real surveys to test orchestration and consistent envelope.

resources.name: GET /table - 15 surveys batch (max limit)
resources.description: Max batch: all 15 surveys at once. Critical performance test for UI scenarios.

resources.name: POST /table - 10 surveys with filter_base
resources.description: POST body with real filter_base scenario: education + area filtering.

resources.name: GET /table - poverty analysis with poverty_line
resources.description: Poverty measures with real poverty line value.

resources.name: GET /table - request area for ALB (missing area)
resources.description: ALB_2016_HBS_CON_ALL lacks 'area' dimension. Should handle gracefully (422 or empty result).

resources.name: GET /table - mixed surveys (some have area, some don't)
resources.description: Mix pip_id and pip_id_6 (ALB without area). Tests heterogeneous dimension handling.

resources.name: GET /table - request dimension not in any survey
resources.description: Request a valid dimension name but not present in the selected surveys.
resources.tests: pm.test('Status is 200 or 422', () => pm.expect([200, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));

resources.name: GET /table - binary analysis_var shares
resources.description: Use gender as analysis_var with share measures.

resources.name: GET /table - continuous covariate (age summary stats)
resources.description: Use age as analysis_var with summary statistics.

resources.name: GET /table - pov_status with multiple poverty lines
resources.description: Run same survey with 3 different poverty lines to test consistency.
resources.tests:
pm.test('Status 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
// Note: Run this 3x with poverty_line = 2.15, 3.2, 6.85 to compare trends

resources.name: PERF - 1 survey baseline
resources.description: Performance baseline: single survey, no disaggregation.

resources.name: PERF - 5 surveys with 2 dimensions
resources.description: Medium complexity: 5 surveys × 2 dimensions.

resources.name: PERF - 15 surveys with 4 dimensions (worst case)
resources.description: Maximum complexity: 15 surveys × 4 dimensions. Critical SLA test.

resources.name: EDGE - very small poverty_line (0.01)
resources.description: Boundary case: near-zero poverty line.

resources.name: EDGE - very large poverty_line (100)
resources.description: Boundary case: poverty line above all welfare values.

resources.name: EDGE - pop_share_threshold at boundary (0.01)
resources.description: Test suppression at exact threshold value.

resources.name: EDGE - all cells suppressed scenario
resources.description: High threshold to trigger suppression of all cells.

resources.name: EDGE - filter_base with multiple categories
resources.description: Complex filter: multiple variables with multiple subcategories.

resources.name: EDGE - filter_base excluding all subcategories
resources.description: Edge case: filter that excludes all observations (should return empty or error).
